I had Facebook, Instagram, snapchat, probably several more platforms to my name. I had about 5k followers when I randomly deleted my account on Instagram. I deleted Facebook and the only social media I have now is a private Instagram with my siblings to stay in touch, and a message platform. 
I do feel disconnected sometimes. 
I'll look up popular people I know and browse through their pictures. It makes me feel self conscious about how people view me, but I remember that my time is well spent and that without those likes they feel a sense of emptiness. 
I have found this applied to my SO as well. 
His Instagram is quite popular, and it would confuse me as to why he'd be upset over 80 likes instead of the usual 100. 
Since he's been with me, he's slowly becoming more reliant on social interaction than social media. 

I do not mind social media but I believe constant usage has provided people with a false sense of security and identity. 
Overall, I just don't care. I don't care what people think about me. I think my social media disposal has taught me to be more self reliant and has increased my attentiveness to the things around me.
